LanguageData.DMS_Turret_LightMachineGun.label: mech LMG
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_LightMachineGun.description:
A weapon specializing in suppression chambered in a large caliber rifle round.
This weapon is specially designed for automatroid use, normal humans will struggle to use it without external equipment or augmentations.
Its folding bipod lets a drafted operator drop it into a firing position on the spot, and pick it back up just as quickly.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_LightMachineGun.label: mech LMG
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_LightMachineGun.description: A light machine gun mounted on a folding bipod.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.desc:
A handheld automatic grenade launcher for clearing out clustered targets.
This weapon is specially designed for automatroid use, normal humans will struggle to use it without external equipment or augmentations.
Dropped onto its tripod it gains the reach and the settled arc it can never hold from the shoulder, and a crew can break it down again in seconds.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.label: mech grenade launcher
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.descrip: An automatic grenade launcher mounted on a low tripod.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_HeavyMachineGun.label: Mech HMG
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_HeavyMachineGun.description:
A heavy machine gun for mech soldiers or infantry support platforms.
This weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use,it's so heavy only specific automatroids can operate it unless it's mounted to a support platform.
On its tripod the receiver stops fighting the gunner: the beaten zone tightens, the belt runs longer, and the gun holds ground no shoulder ever could.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_HeavyMachineGun.label: mech HMG
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_HeavyMachineGun.description: A heavy machine gun mounted on a tripod.
